exposure: irregularity and width of uterine-bladder interface
outcome: Number of transfusions (packed red blood cells, fresh frozen plasma)
cohort: 43 pregnancies with at least one prior cesarean delivery and an ultrasound diagnosis of placenta previa or low-lying placenta with suspected abnormal placentation in the third trimester
finding: Smallest retroplacental myometrial thickness was a significant predictor of successful conservative approach for abnormal placentation in pregnancies with prior cesarean delivery.
